arm_B_best_price_any_book.note: best decimal over all books at the exact (game, player, stat, line)

unstated_details: A fresh numpy Generator is created for each plan (arm A, then each secondary bin); within a plan seasons ascend, weeks ascend, and inside a week the unit draw precedes the rung draw.
Stat-level ROI words use the two-sided p (the larger of the two clusterings); the bin words use the one-sided p for ROI <= 0, as the rule writes for the bins.
The C2 comparator is the ROI of ALL BetRivers t5 rungs, which is the expectation of a random rung draw of the same count.

Bootstrap resampling draws cluster INDICES with replacement from the sorted unique game ids (dates: sorted unique dates) of the season's model rows; the cluster set is the same for every cell and arm, rows of other clusters contribute zero.
A cell whose gate fails gets the word 'NO WORD (gate)'; percentiles are 2.5 and 97.5.
Break-even interval for a realised hit rate is the union of the two clusterings' percentile intervals of the hit rate.
